RikUI.QuestPlanner.View.Open()
local window = RikUI.QuestPlanner.View.Window
-- The window stays shown in a corner so its cards keep refreshing; the captured card moves to a named holder.
local function hold(name, card, width, height)
    window:ClearAllPoints()
    window:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", UIParent, "TOPLEFT", 0, 0)
    local holder = CreateFrame("Frame", name, UIParent)
    holder:SetSize(width, height)
    holder:SetPoint("BOTTOMRIGHT", UIParent, "BOTTOMRIGHT", -100, 100)
    card:SetParent(holder)
    card:ClearAllPoints()
    card:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", holder, "TOPLEFT", 8, -8)
    RikRenderResize(holder)
    return holder
end
hold("RikRenderSummary", window.summary, 840, 160)

RikRenderPlannerSettle()
RikUI.QuestPlanner.View.RefreshWindow()
for _, row in ipairs(window.rows) do if row.questID == 7 then RikUI.QuestPlanner.View.Browse(row) end end
-- The window stays shown in a corner so its cards keep refreshing; the captured card moves to a named holder.
local function hold(name, card, width, height)
    window:ClearAllPoints()
    window:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", UIParent, "TOPLEFT", 0, 0)
    local holder = CreateFrame("Frame", name, UIParent)
    holder:SetSize(width, height)
    holder:SetPoint("BOTTOMRIGHT", UIParent, "BOTTOMRIGHT", -100, 100)
    card:SetParent(holder)
    card:ClearAllPoints()
    card:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", holder, "TOPLEFT", 8, -8)
    RikRenderResize(holder)
    return holder
end
